status: Proposed reliability-first policy, not a locally validated performance ranking.
objective: Correct end-to-end completion first, minimal avoidable human intervention second, then total consumption and elapsed time including retries. Advice selects a primary model, not a mandatory orchestrator plus worker.
rules: Account for supplied subscription context before API list prices: compare included capacity, interruption risk, switching cost and task quality. Already-paid plan prices are not per-task charges or cross-provider quota ratios. Opus has independent evidence for strong knowledge work and competitive terminal coding, but higher-effort token use can be substantial; do not extrapolate Max benchmarks to Medium or Pro endurance.

Claude Opus 5.5 is an additional candidate for coding and knowledge work when Anthropic execution is allowed. Use Claude Code or a verified Anthropic-compatible runtime, with separate access and consumption; a catalog entry does not make it a native Codex model. Start at Medium; raise effort for demonstrated difficulty. Provider evaluations are not a local ranking against Sol or Astra.

Evaluate reasoning difficulty separately from dependent steps, desired autonomy, automatic error detection and late-error cost. Duration, prompt length and repository size alone do not determine the model.
Many independent transformations with schema validation may remain Luna work. Ordinary code spanning data, permissions, interface and integration without supervision can justify Astra Medium.

Prefer OpenAI for ordinary use. Luna handles bounded units; Sol handles well-specified prolonged work; Astra handles dependent autonomous chains and ambiguous diagnosis. These are hypotheses to validate on the actual workflow, not guaranteed win rates.

High and XHigh require a concrete reasoning difficulty, not a generic reliability premium. Escalate for a bounded problem and return after resolution. Missing tools, permissions or evidence are not fixed by more reasoning.
Preserve explicit model and destination restrictions. Never infer that a catalog entry proves account access or effective runtime identity. Mark availability unknown unless checked.

DeepSeek is conditional Ollama Cloud, not local execution or included Codex usage. Require availability, data admissibility and a concrete quota-saving or locally validated benefit. Max benchmarks do not establish Low/High reliability via Ollama.
Do not equate API prices with subscription quota or claim savings without measured total consumption. Consider context, cache and retries. Choice probabilities are not calibrated success rates.
Use existing tests, checkpoints and completion evidence. A model change cannot reset formal retry budgets, weaken review gates, authorize delegation or cause automatic provider switching.

Distinguish faithful extraction from interpretation: exact quotations can be Luna work, while reconciling conflicting sources can require Sol or Astra. Prefer the cheaper plausible profile only when expected reliability remains sufficient.

Do not research new benchmarks on every consultation. Refresh relevant sources when a model becomes unavailable or current performance is explicitly requested. Jev chooses within this supplied grid; it does not invent missing benchmarks.

profiles.usage: Simple, bounded extraction or rewriting when Anthropic execution is allowed and latency matters. Verify quality before using reduced effort; not the default for dependent autonomous work. Requires eligible data and verified model/effort access in Claude Code or an Anthropic-compatible runtime; separate from native Codex usage.

Default Opus 5.5 starting point for coding, source synthesis and prolonged tool-based knowledge work. Consider alongside Sol for well-specified execution and Astra for dependent autonomous work. Validate with the actual harness; no established local advantage over either model. Requires eligible data and verified model/effort access in Claude Code or an Anthropic-compatible runtime; separate from native Codex usage.

Opus work with a specific difficult diagnosis, architectural tradeoff or conflicting evidence requiring deeper reasoning than Medium. Return to Medium after the bounded difficulty is resolved; duration alone is insufficient. Requires eligible data and verified model/effort access in Claude Code or an Anthropic-compatible runtime; separate from native Codex usage.

Demanding long-horizon coding or agentic reasoning when High is insufficient or the reasoning difficulty is explicit and extra token use is acceptable. Require checkpoints and end-to-end verification, not a generic reliability premium. Requires eligible data and verified model/effort access in Claude Code or an Anthropic-compatible runtime; separate from native Codex usage.

Exceptional reasoning bottleneck with concrete justification beyond XHigh and an accepted consumption budget. Not a routine execution profile or a guarantee of correctness. Requires eligible data and verified model/effort access in Claude Code or an Anthropic-compatible runtime; separate from native Codex usage.
Short translation, titles, simple rephrasing, classification, exact extraction or locating a known file. Low ambiguity and easily checked output. No architecture or sensitive judgment.
Bounded inventory, extraction with several constraints or a small known-cause fix with a clear test. A long document alone does not require a larger model for mechanical work.

Substantial but bounded implementation with stable contracts, multistep logic and observable tests. A verifiable unit, not the default owner of a long unsupervised integration chain. No unresolved product, permissions or architecture decisions.
Same bounded scope with a concrete reasoning difficulty unresolved at High or otherwise demonstrated. Exceptional, not the default for inventory, extraction or running tests.

Faithful synthesis, meeting preparation, polished writing, scoped comparative research and ordinary development. First candidate for prolonged well-defined execution with stable contracts and solid automatic validation. Consider Astra Medium when dependencies, context recovery or costly late errors make supervision expensive.

Sol-level work with specific intertwined constraints or contradictions that Medium may mishandle. Not an automatic premium for long tasks. For cross-step drift and coordination risk, consider Astra Medium instead of increasing effort by habit.

First candidate for prolonged autonomous work with interdependent steps, multiple tools/components, context recovery or costly late errors, even for ordinary code. Also architecture, ambiguous diagnosis, complex planning, strategic judgment and demanding visual acceptance. Can be chosen directly without forcing small-model failures; expected benefit requires local verification.
Precisely identified critical reasoning difficulty unresolved at Medium or clearly justifying deeper analysis. One bounded pass, then return to Medium after resolution.
Exceptional complexity with a documented impasse at High or equivalent concrete justification. Never automatic for a large phase, long document or important request.

Conditional Ollama Cloud option for classification, data transformation or drafts from supplied excerpts. Bounded and easy to check, to preserve Codex quota or reproduce a favorable local comparison. Not a systematic Luna replacement or unrestricted repository exploration.

Conditional Ollama Cloud option for synthesis of selected excerpts, test proposals or an isolated fix with explicit contract and verification. Requires a quota-saving goal or favorable local evidence. Not the default owner of long interdependent autonomous execution. Max benchmarks do not prove High performance.
